In this task, you will set up a player scene and control script in Godot 4 to manage character locomotion and attacking animations using an `AnimationTree` state machine.

- `trigger_attack()`: Initiates the attack transition.
- `current_state() -> StringName`: Returns the current active node name from the state-machine playback.

### Requirements
- The project must run successfully under `godot --headless`.

extends SceneTree

func _init() -> void:
	var root = Node2D.new()
	root.name = "Player"
	
	# AnimationPlayer
	var anim_player = AnimationPlayer.new()
	anim_player.name = "AnimationPlayer"
	
	var lib = AnimationLibrary.new()
	
	var anims = ["idle", "walk_north", "walk_south", "walk_east", "walk_west", "attack"]
	for anim_name in anims:
		var anim = Animation.new()
		anim.length = 0.5
		var track_idx = anim.add_track(Animation.TYPE_VALUE)
		anim.track_set_path(track_idx, ".:position")
		anim.track_insert_key(track_idx, 0.0, Vector2.ZERO)
		lib.add_animation(anim_name, anim)
	
	anim_player.add_animation_library("", lib)
	root.add_child(anim_player)
	anim_player.owner = root
	
	# AnimationTree
	var anim_tree = AnimationTree.new()
	anim_tree.name = "AnimationTree"
	anim_tree.anim_player = NodePath("../AnimationPlayer")
	
	var sm = AnimationNodeStateMachine.new()
	
	# Locomotion state
	var blend = AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D.new()
	blend.min_space = Vector2(-1, -1)
	blend.max_space = Vector2(1, 1)
	blend.blend_mode = AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D.BLEND_MODE_INTERPOLATED
	
	var points = {
		"idle": Vector2(0, 0),
		"walk_north": Vector2(0, -1),
		"walk_south": Vector2(0, 1),
		"walk_east": Vector2(1, 0),
		"walk_west": Vector2(-1, 0)
	}
	for name in points:
		var node_anim = AnimationNodeAnimation.new()
		node_anim.animation = name
		blend.add_blend_point(node_anim, points[name])
	
	sm.add_node("Locomotion", blend, Vector2(200, 100))
	
	# Attack state
	var attack = AnimationNodeAnimation.new()
	attack.animation = "attack"
	sm.add_node("Attack", attack, Vector2(500, 100))
	
	# Transitions
	var t1 = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.new()
	t1.switch_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.SWITCH_MODE_IMMEDIATE
	t1.advance_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.ADVANCE_MODE_AUTO
	t1.advance_condition = "condition_attack"
	sm.add_transition("Locomotion", "Attack", t1)
	
	var t2 = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.new()
	t2.switch_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.SWITCH_MODE_AT_END
	t2.advance_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.ADVANCE_MODE_DISABLED
	sm.add_transition("Attack", "Locomotion", t2)
	
	anim_tree.tree_root = sm
	root.add_child(anim_tree)
	anim_tree.owner = root
	
	# PlayerAnimController
	var controller = Node.new()
	controller.name = "PlayerAnimController"
	controller.set_script(load("res://scripts/PlayerAnimController.gd"))
	root.add_child(controller)
	controller.owner = root
	
	# Save scene
	var packed = PackedScene.new()
	packed.pack(root)
	var err = ResourceSaver.save(packed, "res://scenes/Player.tscn")
	print("Save result: ", err)
	quit()
BUILDER_EOF
